_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9W9eKaPHQSNGAfHX12ERwnj)_
Fixes #28934

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`metadata.endpoints.item` 的 describe 补上它实际已经关掉的第 13 条路由 `GET /meta/app/:appId/bundle`,QA 清单条目 `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract` 的步骤、验收[2]和变体行同步改为 13 条。
- 为什么改:#27627 让应用元数据包路由走逐项注册器，挂载表测试已钉 13 条，但公开 schema 的说明还写 12 条;18.3.0 候选版 QA 跑 #28929 判为 FAIL。分诊裁定代码是对的、改说明。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字和 QA 清单，不动任何路由、默认值或可接受值;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts`(item 的 describe)、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`(steps[7]、acceptance[2]、变体行、revision 9)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`,预期全绿，且 describe 列出的路由与该测试 `metadata.endpoints.item` 行的 13 条一一对应。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts`: the `metadata.endpoints.item` `.describe()` now names `GET /meta/app/:appId/bundle` after the book tree, with the reason it rides this switch (it registers through the same per-item registrar because every member the bundle serves is the item read's own answer, the pin's own words). The `endpoints` block header counts no routes, so it is unchanged.
- `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx`: regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, one row).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`, item `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract`: steps[7] and acceptance[2].clause enumerate thirteen mounts including the bundle; the variant row reads `switch:endpoints.item (13 mounts)`; revision 8 to 9 with a history entry. `coverage.json` and `FOLLOW-UPS.md` derive nothing from these fields (no hit for the count in either), so nothing is regenerated there.
- Bounded in-place fix in the same item: the title said `prefix moves eleven mounts`; the default table has twenty metadata mounts (the `api.enableMetadata` row of the mount-table pin) and acceptance[1] asserts that the whole table re-bases, so the title now says `prefix moves every metadata mount`. Same defect class (a count in this item that drifted from the pin), mechanical, same file and gate family. Declared for the seat to amend the claim's file surface.
- `.changeset/28934-endpoints-item-bundle-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

Forced test edits: none. No spec or dogfood test pins the twelve-route sentence or count; the dogfood harness and live tests read the item by acceptance index only.

## Tests

- `packages/spec`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` 789/789 files, 23325 passed, 1 todo; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `packages/rest`: `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` + `rest-sub-config-parse-not-cast.test.ts` 2/2 files, 49/49 tests.
- `packages/qa/dogfood`: `test/rest-config-contract-harness.test.ts` 1/1 file, 7/7 tests.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 0 (16 areas, 352 items).

## Acceptance notes

Three comments outside the claimed file surface still state the old radius. They are drift in prose nobody parses, so they are noted here, not filed (carrier: none):

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, the `registerPerItemRoute` docblock in `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, lists the radius without the bundle (the claim excludes the mount code).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` file header says `metadata.endpoints.item` gates TWELVE (and "eleven of them moving"); its table and the per-case comment already say thirteen.
- `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`, the `endpoints.item` row's note says "twelve mounts".

`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` names this checklist item but states no count, so there is no governed follow-up.

## Verification

Measured at base 135054eb, head 94cfe512. Derived gate list and its reconciliation are in the report comment on #28934.
